item.title: Multiple lights out on column C375; 2 spot lights, 1 sign light, and 1 globe light, 18th August
item.description:
Multiple lights are out on column C375; 2 spotlights, 1 sign light, and 1 globe light To the southeast side of Fox Hill Green, on Auckland Road, a number of lights are out, as attached to the lighting column on the traffic island to the width restrictor here. The following lights are out: 1) Globe light atop of column C375 2) Spotlight, SP112 3) Spotlight, SP11? (the last digit is illegible to this asset's ID stickers) 4) Sign light, L912 Please could all four lights be re-illuminated? A sign light on the opposite side is illuminated, showing that power to this column is not the fault. Due to the image upload limit to this report, I will attach additional photos in an additional response to this report; please do see to these additional photos.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Auckland Road, Crystal Palace, Greater London
